definitions.explanation: A metal container with a spout and handle used for boiling water. Typically placed on a stovetop. Used for making tea, instant noodles, etc.

examples.japanese: やかんでお{湯|ゆ}を{沸|わ}かす。
examples.english: I boil water in a kettle.

examples.japanese: やかんが{沸騰|ふっとう}している。
やかんを{火|ひ}にかけてください。
examples.english: Please put the kettle on the stove.

examples.japanese: やかんのお{湯|ゆ}が{沸|わ}いたら、{教|おし}えてね。
examples.english: Let me know when the water in the kettle boils.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}いやかんを{新|あたら}しい{電気|でんき}ケトルに{買|か}い{替|か}えたら、お{湯|ゆ}がすぐに{沸|わ}くようになった。
examples.english: After I replaced the old kettle with a new electric one, the water started boiling much faster.

notes:
Traditional stovetop kettle, as opposed to {電気|でんき}ケトル (electric kettle). Usually written in hiragana, though the kanji {薬缶|やかん} exists (originally meant 'medicine container').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・やかんを{沸|わ}かす (boil the kettle)
・やかんを{火|ひ}にかける (put the kettle on)
・やかんでお{湯|ゆ}を{沸|わ}かす (boil water in a kettle)

COUNTER: {個|こ} or {台|だい}
